what_this_measures: This sweep compares every delivered root HTML page that is tabbed by the id="pn-search" marker against the real ssot.projectors.screen_partial_note computation on that page's own rendered screening panel body. It identifies pages whose served screen banner already contains the computed sentence, pages that still serve a stale partial-screen sentence, pages whose stale sentence visibly denies material present below it, pages where no partial note is expected, reverse mismatches where a note is served despite a None computation, and pages that cannot be assessed from the required markers.
